steps.en: Work item for the appeal appears on the officer's dashboard
steps.id: Work item untuk appeal muncul di dashboard officer
steps.why_en: No work item screen or creation exists; only a placeholder.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar maupun pembuatan work item, hanya placeholder.

steps.en: Officer sees the ID, notices and address to decide
steps.id: Officer melihat ID, notice, dan alamat untuk memutuskan
steps.why_en: Generic HST pages show ID, notices and address, but not the appeal's alternative address.
steps.why_id: Halaman HST umum menampilkan ID, notice, alamat, tapi bukan alamat alternatif dari appeal.

steps.en: Officer decides to resend the reminder to the alternative address
steps.id: Officer memutuskan kirim ulang reminder ke alamat alternatif
steps.why_en: No resend decision exists; only the revival screen indirectly causes a resend.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada keputusan resend; hanya layar revival yang tidak langsung memicunya.

steps.en: Officer decides not to resend the reminder
steps.id: Officer memutuskan tidak mengirim ulang reminder
steps.why_en: Only the HST suspension screen exists; the decision itself is not recorded.
steps.why_id: Hanya layar suspension HST yang ada; keputusannya sendiri tidak dicatat.

steps.why_en: Only a generic confirm pop-up; no decision record and no work item to close.
steps.why_id: Hanya pop-up konfirmasi umum; tidak ada catatan keputusan dan tidak ada work item untuk ditutup.
